request.description: Sends the person an SMS with a one-time link to confirm consent for the published consent template `context` (default: the lead source's consent context, else `lead_capture`). Earlier pending links for the same template are cancelled. Refused when the person has no mobile that may be contacted. Needs `CONSENT_LINK_URL` (503 otherwise) and the `SMS_DLT_TEMPLATE_CONSENT_REQUEST` DLT id in production. Staff only, lead update access.
